_about: Generated by env/generate_aplus_tasks.py from env/fixtures/aplus_dev.json. Do not hand edit.
Seed 900, tee draw 9801, water draw 50865, brand Larchmere, an A+ market
The protocol's question templates word for word, eight about the tee, five about the
water and two the block should not plan, every key computed from the fixture's variants
and checked against _instance where the two overlap. The three questions with two
readings keep the menu reading here; the buyable reading is in the readings sidecar.
"box" says what the protocol asks the block to do with each question. It is not yet
checked against the box, which reads one results page.
"fixture" names the market's fixture, so the analysis tools read its ground truth.
Then 16 development rewordings from experiments/tasks/paraphrases_v1.json, written for
Thornwood's clothing questions and in sample (the model parser's prompt v2 and its
normalisation were written from them), each that keeps its meaning and rewords a
question asked here of the tee, re-branded to Larchmere: a task with its template's
keys, id pv1-NN and the template's id under "template". The other 14 are in _skipped,
each with the reason. For a pilot only: no claim is made on them (LESSONS 19).
_environment: Tees and bottled water under one brand (Larchmere), seeded on 22 October 2026 beside the
markets already in the shop, which it leaves as they were, under its own SKU prefix and
URL keys (IGR-DEV, igr-dev-NN.html). 42 listings, 21 tees and 21 water, across 2 results
pages at the shop's page size of 36, no setting changed. Three availability states for
every size and pack: absent from the menu, present but disabled because it is sold out
(show_out_of_stock set to 1), or present and buyable. Under the gated theme only the
advertised price shows until a size or pack is chosen.
